scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Reading the Quran begins with the Noorani Qaida.
The Qaida has 17 lessons, from single letters to reading words of the Quran.
Your child learns the letters and their sounds, then joins them into words.
Classes are 30 minutes, which suits young children from age 4.
After every class, the teacher records the lesson your child reached.
